question: Estimate the daily Instagram reels watched per Indian user (active reels viewer).
idealClarificationQuestions: Average across all Indian Instagram users or only those who watch reels? Active reels viewers.
'Watched' means tapped through or watched >3 seconds? Watched at least 3 seconds (Meta's view definition).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: average user time on reels per day × average reel length watched.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Active Instagram reels viewers in India: ~250M DAU.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Reels watched per day per user: 30 × 60 ÷ 13 = ~140 reels.
